mapper.sql: id, title, author, publisher, isbn, category_id, seller_id, original_price, price, `condition`, description, cover_image, stock, status, view_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS b_id, b.title AS b_title, b.author AS b_author, b.publisher AS b_publisher, b.isbn AS b_isbn, b.category_id AS b_category_id, b.seller_id AS b_seller_id, b.original_price AS b_original_price, b.price AS b_price, b.`condition` AS b_condition, b.description AS b_description, b.cover_image AS b_cover_image, b.stock AS b_stock, b.status AS b_status, b.view_count AS b_view_count, b.create_time AS b_create_time, b.update_time AS b_update_time, u.nickname AS u_nickname, c.name AS c_name FROM book b LEFT JOIN user u ON b.seller_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, publisher, isbn, category_id, seller_id, original_price, price, `condition`, description, cover_image, stock, status, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{isbn}, #{categoryId}, #{sellerId}, #{originalPrice}, #{price}, #{condition}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{viewCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
